s1Facts.label: Listing, share classes & governance
s1Facts.value: Nasdaq: ANT · Class A / N / F / T
s1Facts.detail: Applied to list Class A common on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under ticker “ANT”; a “controlled company.” Preferred Series A, C-1, D-1, D-2, E-1, F-1, G-1, H-1 convert to Class A (1 vote). Series B, C-2, D-3, E-2…E-5, F-2, G-2…G-4, H-2…H-4 convert to Class N (non-voting, not listed, not registered; converts to Class A on a “qualifying transfer,” S-1 pp. 20, 309). Class F (1 share, Founder LLC) carries 50.1% of the vote. Class T (1 share, Long-Term Benefit Trust) elects a majority of the board.

s1Facts.label: Strategic holders (Amazon, Google, Broadcom)
s1Facts.detail: Amazon's convertible notes convert into Class N at the IPO up to its ownership cap; remainder converts quarterly afterwards (lowest of fixed price, IPO price, 10-day VWAP) or is repaid in cash at maturity (S-1 pp. 20, 165). Google 2026 NPA ownership cap: 14.99% of outstanding capitalization, post-money, as-converted (S-1 p. 169; non-voting Class N holdings do not appear in the ownership table, pp. 289–290). Broadcom (“Infrastructure Partner 2026”) notes may be settled in cash or Class N shares (S-1 p. 168).
